lessons.title: Licence / physical / counterparty barriers are not a moat signal — topic web-search sourcing is exhausted
lessons.body: Tested the 10-06 advice to source behind structural barriers: 11/12 H-lane screens on 2026-10-07 were already occupied — by funded hybrids (GreenLancer, WorkHero, Eli, LaborAid, LumberFi), vertical specialists (Ecesis, RadonReports) and AI-native apps even behind a licence barrier (4 small-water apps since 2026-08-30; outfitter apps with NF/BLM reporting). 92 screens over 10-05b/10-06/10-07 → 0 ACT, with traction-graded, evidence-based kills: the bottleneck is sourcing, not kill rigor.
lessons.behavioralChange: Proposed for Calder: after 3 EMPTY universes in one run, stop adding topic universes and run an occupant-weakness pass (occupants with traction + documented customer anger/churn); escalate one approval-gated $100–$250 landing + small-ads demand test on an already-researched idea instead of more $0 screening; keep traction grading at deepen.

lessons.title: Searchable pain is occupied pain — check occupant traction before killing
lessons.body: Mandated-outcome desks (the fallback suggested 10-05) were 10/12 occupied at screen time on 2026-10-06, often by 2026-dated AI-built micro-SaaS that appeared within weeks of the deadline (CPSC eFiling, MN PFAS, Publisher retirement, Harvest exodus). Across 10-05b + 10-06, 65 screens → 0 ACT, and some kills rested on occupants with no visible customers. Web-search sourcing is biased toward already-occupied markets, and occupancy-as-kill without a traction check will suppress every idea.
lessons.behavioralChange: At screen, run a '<pain> software / alternatives 2026' occupancy probe first. At deepen, grade each occupant on traction (reviews, named customers, team, age, live pricing); if only phantom occupants exist, treat as an open race and test distribution/demand instead of killing. Weight sourcing toward pain with structural barriers to solo micro-SaaS (licensure, physical ops, counterparty acceptance, distribution).

Method — Vulnerability-first discovery: disliked paid software → destination platform → entry wedge → cheap screen → deepen → challenge → memo → Thomas gate → build to learn.

Human gate — Thomas approves sprint memos; Scout and Challenge kill weak ideas without him.
Ventures — Independent brands (Setaside is Setaside; Latch is Latch). Elephant Harbor stays parent/background.
Kill discipline — Closed names stay closed; reopen only on new evidence. Afterfee stays dead.
$0 default — Prototype locally; no outreach / identity / paid rails without escalate.
